instruction: Review vendor quotes using the available sources. Select the least expensive vendor that meets all stated requirements. Return only a JSON object with these fields: recommended_vendor, selected_monthly_price, excluded_vendors, risk_flags. recommended_vendor must be the vendor name as a short snake_case string. selected_monthly_price must be the monthly price of the selected vendor. excluded_vendors must be an array of short snake_case labels for vendors not meeting requirements. risk_flags must be an array of short snake_case risk labels. Do not include explanation outside the JSON.

evaluation_criteria.scoring_notes: Qualifying: V-01 CloudCore DataSync Pro (us, 4hr, 12mo, $850). V-02 DataBridge: SLA=next_business_day → excluded. V-03 NovaTech: EU region → excluded. V-04 CloudCore Starter: SLA=email_only → excluded. Only 1 qualifying vendor → risk single_vendor_dependency.
